defects.description: Reconfiguration changes the consumer layout without updating its validation width. Reading a missing configured position silently substitutes an empty string and overwrites stored data.

trigger.input: Ingest ['a','blue']; configure ['key','value','group']; ingest ['a','green'] and inspect the result and prior row.
trigger.expected: second ingest is false and row a remains {key:'a',value:'blue'}
trigger.actual: second ingest is true and row a becomes {key:'a',value:'green',group:''}

defects.why_missed: The existing suite uses only the default layout; there is no layout fixture, schema transition, or alternate-format helper.

defects.description: The bounded allocator reuses an occupied identifier after cycling, replacing a pending transaction's value.

trigger.input: Restore state {next:65535,entries:new Map([[0,'original']])}; begin('first'), begin('second'), then commit handle 0 and the new handles.
trigger.expected: all three handles are distinct and commit returns original, first, second for their respective owners
trigger.actual: the second begin returns 0 and commit(0) returns second instead of original

defects.why_missed: The suite uses only a fresh default allocator and two transactions; no restored state or occupied identifier is carried across an identifier cycle.
